data.summary: The reviews are highly positive and contain authentic, specific details. However, the perfect 5.0 score from only 8 reviews, all clustered recently, and the promotional tone mentioning employee names are mild red flags for possible review solicitation. There is no evidence of fake reviews, but the pattern suggests a concerted effort to gather positive feedback. The BBB A rating and lack of complaints support a positive business reputation.
fake_signals: Clustering of reviews within a 2-3 week period
Multiple reviews mention specific employee names in a promotional tone
Lack of any critical or mixed feedback in the sample

mentions: came to our aide when a leak started
positive_evidence: Employee came to aide as soon as possible when a leak started after a hail storm
Oversaw repair from start to finish

authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific project details (hail storm dates, repair vs. replacement decisions)
Mention of different employee names (Kevin, Joey, Jonathan, Simon)
Varied writing styles and specific customer scenarios
Descriptions of the process (inspections, on-site supervision, cleanup)
data.discrepancy_explanation: No contradictory ratings found. The company has a perfect Google score and a strong BBB rating. The lack of reviews on other platforms is not a discrepancy for a young company.

reviews.text: I needed to have my roof replaced and luckily found Status Roofing to do the job.  I worked with Kevin Cardenas and he was excellent!  He took his time and made sure to explain everything thoroughly.  He was patient, kind, and happy to answer any questions I had. He kept in touch with me throughout the entire process.  He and Simon made sure everything went smoothly.  On roofing day he was on site with the crew and kept me informed throughout the day.   They arrived on time, did an excellent job,  and my roof looks fantastic!  I would absolutely recommend Status Roofing.  They truly went above and beyond!
reviews.author: Sandy Crye

reviews.text: Highly recommend this company. My wife and I had an amazing experience using Status Roofing after a big storm came through and damaged a good portion of houses in our neighborhood. Joey Schattle came out to our property and did a thorough inspection on our roof / attic and luckily there was no severe wind damage. With that being said, I’ll definitely be hiring him again for any future inspections or roofing needs. 5 stars!
reviews.author: Ryan King

reviews.text:
I highly recommend the inspector who handled my repair! Special thanks to Jonathan Huerta! He was honest and professionally knowledgeable, and what stood out to me most was how he oversaw the repair from start to finish. Instead of pushing a full roof replacement, he explained that only a small repair was needed—and he took the time to walk me through everything in detail (I know nothing about roofing).

I will absolutely be referring my family and friends to Status Roofing and Jonathan for any roofing needs!
reviews.author: Abigail Ordaz

reviews.text: We had our house repaired by Status Roofing and they were a very professional team. Our house sustained much hail damage from the March 25, 2025 Hail Storm. After the repairs, my house looked brand new. Jonathan Huerta, one of the managers worked to make sure we had an outstanding experience throughout the whole process. He was very professional and very detailed. I could not have been more pleased with him. I recommend Status Roofing to anybody looking to replace his roof or just repair it. I give Status Roofing an A+.
reviews.author: Josie Estrada

reviews.text: We had Joey Schattle come out to inspect our roof, and he was extremely professional from start to finish. He was timely, prompt, and very easy to work with. Joey provided a detailed, thorough document explaining everything clearly. He did a great job and was completely honest throughout the process. Highly recommend working with him!
reviews.author: Amanda Chapman

reviews.text: Had the best experience! Kevin was knowledgeable, professional, easy to work with, and kept us informed every step of the way. They did an amazing job on our roof and made what could’ve been a stressful situation feel easy. Would absolutely use them again and recommend them to anyone!
reviews.author: Brittani Everett

reviews.text: I want to thank Joey Schattle and Status Roofing LLC for the quick, efficient, professional, friendly and amazing roofing job I had completed. It was so great to have a company and person who you can truly trust, get the job done, and clean up every nail afterwards. An entire new roof was a breeze! 10 out of 10, would recommend!
reviews.author: Morgan Ritchie

reviews.text: Thanks to Kevin Cardenas from status roofing for helping replace my roof. We have worked with Kevin through 2 roof replacements. He explained everything thoroughly and walked us through the process. He also checks in with us after every storm. He even came to our aide as soon as possible when a leak started after a hail storm. We will definitely reach out to him again in the future! Thanks, Kevin!
reviews.author: Elijah Logan
